name: Teyo Verada
description: Teyo Verada is a young shieldmage from the desert world of Gobakhan whose magic makes geometric shields of white light, a planeswalker who lost his spark in the Spark Rupture.

"Teyo Verada", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

summary.text: Teyo Verada is a young shieldmage from the desert world of Gobakhan whose magic makes geometric shields of white light, a planeswalker who lost his spark in the Spark Rupture.

citations.text: "Teyo Verada". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Teyo Verada". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Teyo Verada", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: His powers first appeared at age four when a diamondstorm killed his family, and he became the worst acolyte in the Order of the Shieldmage.

citations.text: "Teyo Verada", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Teyo Verada", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: His spark ignited as he was suffocating in the sand and he planeswalked to Ravnica, where Rat adopted him and Kaya and Ral Zarek explained he was a planeswalker.

citations.text: "Teyo Verada", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.
"Teyo Verada", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: During Bolas's invasion he traveled with Kaya and Rat to rally the Orzhov, Selesnya, Gruul, Golgari and Rakdos, shielding his allies from Eternals along the way.

citations.text: "Teyo Verada", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Teyo Verada", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

bio.text: He shielded the participants of the Guildpact Chamber ritual from God-Eternal Kefnet until it was completed and Niv-Mizzet was reborn.

citations.text: "Teyo Verada", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Niv-Mizzet", section "Operation Desperation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

bio.text: After the war he visited Gobakhan, found his powers outshone the monks, and went with Kaya and Rat to Dominaria, where he freed Liliana from her trance and carried the Chain Veil to Ravnica as proof of her death.

citations.text: "Teyo Verada", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Teyo Verada", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Teyo Verada", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He then traveled with Kaya and Rat to Fiora to join Liliana, now called Ana Iora.

citations.text: "Teyo Verada", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kaya Cassir", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: Teyo lost his spark in the Spark Rupture and returned to Gobakhan to protect his home.

citations.text: "Teyo Verada", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana subdues Zahid with the Veil, then gives up the Veil as the Spirit-Gem fades; Teyo sends it to Ravnica as proof of her death.
timeline.quote: Liliana dropped the Veil and gave it up

citation.text: "Chain Veil", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heroes seek Rakdos's aid during the War of the Spark but Rakdos refuses.
timeline.quote: Although Rakdos himself refused to aid

citation.text: "Rix Maadi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the war Teyo returns alone looking for Rat, fights Whipsaw and speaks with Hekara, leaving empty-handed.
timeline.quote: After the war, Teyo returned alone, looking for Rat.

citation.text: "Rix Maadi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teyo Verada's first planeswalk lands him in the middle of the Promenade, where Araithia Shokta helps him out of the cart traffic.
timeline.quote: Teyo Verada had his first planeswalk

citation.text: "Transguild Promenade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the war Teyo finds Rat again at the Promenade and they walk off together.
timeline.quote: Teyo and Rat walked off together, arm in arm.

citation.text: "Transguild Promenade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the battle Angrath wants to destroy the Immortal Sun but is vetoed, and tells Teyo to pity the loved ones left behind.
timeline.quote: telling the boy not to pity the dead – for their suffering is over – but rather to pity the loved ones they left behind.

citation.text: "Angrath", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rat guides Teyo, newly arrived on Ravnica, sharing what she overheard about planeswalking.
timeline.quote: Rat acted as Teyo Verada 's guide to the city plane when the young planeswalker first arrived.

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rat, Teyo and Kaya meet the Orzhov triumvirate, and Bilagru convinces them to join the fight against Bolas.
timeline.quote: the triumvirate agreed to have the Orzhov Syndicate join the fight

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Selesnya agrees to help after Trostani awakens and overrules Emmara Tandris.
timeline.quote: her decision was overruled when Trostani awakened and ruled in favor of helping the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Rix Maadi, Tomik brings Hekara's corpse, the cultists resurrect her as a blood witch, and she defeats Exava and leads the Rakdos against Bolas.
timeline.quote: the Rakdos cultists resurrected Hekara as a blood witch

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heartbroken that Teyo and Kaya will leave, Rat departs without goodbye, but Teyo finds her and she joins them.
timeline.quote: Rat was heart-broken and left their company before saying goodbye

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Dominaria, Rat helps find Liliana, defeat an imposter, and persuade Kaya to let Liliana live.
timeline.quote: Rat helped convince Kaya to let Liliana live

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emmara first declines Kaya's plan to revive Niv-Mizzet, but Harmony wakes and the Selesnya join the fight against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Harmony, the middle Trostani, finally woke up and decided that Selesnya would be joining the other guilds to defeat Bolas.

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya befriends Teyo and fights Bolas's forces with Araithia and Ral.
timeline.quote: Alongside many other planeswalkers and Ravnicans, Kaya fought against Bolas' forces

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Trostani awakens and the Selesnya agree to help the Gatewatch; Araithia wins over the Gruul.
timeline.quote: Trostani awakened and ruled in favor of helping the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: God-Eternal Kefnet attacks the ritual and Teyo Verada shields the participants until it is completed; Niv-Mizzet is reborn with golden scales and a decagon on his chest.
timeline.quote: Teyo Verada shielded the guild representatives and bystanders long enough for the ritual to be completed.

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "Operation Desperation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Azorius Senate House, Kaya, Vraska and Ral report on their assignments; Ral admits Tezzeret lived and faces a failed no-confidence vote.
timeline.quote: the vote was unsuccessful as Ral solidified his support within the guild and remained guildmaster.

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "The New Living Guildpact". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska pledges the Golgari to the fight against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Vraska pledged the Golgari to the fight against Bolas

citation.text: "Ral Zarek", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lazav, disguised as Saheeli, attends the Planewide Celebration, leaving Teyo to wonder where the real Saheeli is.
timeline.quote: it turned out to be Lazav disguised as her, leaving Teyo to wonder what happened to the real Saheeli

citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya, Teyo and Rat ask Selesnya's help to revive Niv-Mizzet; Emmara declines but Harmony wakes and commits Selesnya to the alliance against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Harmony, the middle Trostani, finally woke up and decided that Selesnya would be joining the other guilds to defeat Bolas.

citation.text: "Selesnya Conclave", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teyo's powers first manifest at age four when a diamondstorm kills his parents and sister; Abbot Barrez finds him.
timeline.quote: when his parents and his sister were killed in a diamondstorm

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teyo becomes the worst acolyte in the Order of the Shieldmage under orthodox training.
timeline.quote: Teyo became the worst acolyte in the Order of the Shieldmage

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teyo's spark ignites and he planeswalks to Ravnica, called by the Interplanar Beacon, escaping suffocation in the sand.
timeline.quote: Teyo's spark ignited

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teyo wanders Ravnica, guided by Rat, and is joined by Kaya and Ral Zarek, who explain he is a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: who explained to him that he was a planeswalker

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas's invasion begins; Teyo uses his shields to protect allies and hinder Eternals.
timeline.quote: he used his shields to protect his allies and hinder Eternals

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya, Teyo and Rat rally the Orzhov Syndicate after Bilagru convinces the triumvirate.
timeline.quote: the triumvirate agreed to have the Orzhov Syndicate join the fight

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska returns, unites the Golgari and pledges them to the fight against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Vraska pledged the Golgari to the fight against Bolas

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hekara is resurrected as a blood witch and leads the Rakdos against Bolas.
timeline.quote: the Rakdos cultists resurrected Hekara as a blood witch

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Guildpact Chamber ritual Teyo shields against Kefnet twice, and Niv-Mizzet, resurrected, incinerates Kefnet.
timeline.quote: Teyo managed to create a mighty shield to stop the God-Eternal twice

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teyo chooses to remain on Ravnica after the Immortal Sun is disabled and survives the battle.
timeline.quote: He survived the battle and was present during the Planewide Celebration

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya takes Teyo and Rat to Gobakhan; Teyo finds his powers far outshine the monks and leaves again.
timeline.quote: Teyo discovered that his powers now far outshone those of his fellow monks and acolytes

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Dominaria Teyo frees Liliana from her trance and deduces that the fake Liliana draws power from a bound djinn.
timeline.quote: Teyo attempted to remove the gold collar from Liliana's neck, which jolted her back to her senses

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rat destroys the amulet freeing Zahid, who tries to kill Teyo; Liliana subdues Zahid with the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Liliana then used the Chain Veil to subdue Zahid and save Teyo.

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana is allowed to live; Teyo transports the Veil to Ravnica as proof of her death, and Niv-Mizzet locks it in a puzzle box.
timeline.quote: Liliana was allowed to live, although proof of a kill would be needed.

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teyo travels with Kaya and Rat to Fiora to join Liliana, now called Ana Iora, on her path to redemption.
timeline.quote: Liliana, who had changed her name to Ana Iora

citation.text: "Teyo Verada", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teyo materializes on the Promenade covered in sand, and Rat adopts him.
timeline.quote: And as a sand-covered boy materialized right in front of me.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat learns Teyo is from Gobakhan and an acolyte of the Shieldmage Order and explains that he has planeswalked to Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Teyo, I've a feeling you're not on Gobakhan anymore.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat tells Teyo about the Living Guildpact Jace's absence and Vraska's assassination of Isperia.
timeline.quote: Mistress Vraska—she's the Golgari guildmaster—assassinated Mistress Isperia, the Azorius guildmaster.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat and Teyo arrive at Tenth District Plaza and find a new obelisk and pyramid crowned with dragon statues.
timeline.quote: Sometime—sometime very recently—it had risen out of the ground, displacing buildings and gardens and whatever else used to be there.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: A giant portal opens and splits the Embassy of the Guildpact, killing bystanders, and Bolas gloats from his pyramid.
timeline.quote: A gigantic portal—easily fifty yards tall—had opened up behind us, instantly decimating the Embassy of the Guildpact, sheering it right in half.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek and Kaya fight the Eternals and save civilians, while Rat and Teyo recover from their shock.
timeline.quote: Mistress Kaya said, "Run."

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo shields Kaya from a mineralized minotaur while Rat stabs it, and Zarek electrocutes it.
timeline.quote: He stood over Mistress Kaya, erecting a triangular shield of light to protect her and himself from the creature.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Zarek's goggles identify Teyo as a Planeswalker, and Kaya asks if there are others.
timeline.quote: You're a Planeswalker.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: The raven-haired woman watches the planeswalkers and Rat fight, then leaves for the pyramid.
timeline.quote: her shaking her head in pity, if not disgust

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo uses shields in battle, and the group learns most guilds have retreated or serve Bolas.
timeline.quote: The rest of the guilds have retreated to shore up their own territories, more suspicious of one another than of Bolas.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat, stunned by news of Hekara's death, stabs an Eternal about to kill Teyo, and Kaya takes Rat and Teyo with her.
timeline.quote: Furious, I leapt at it and stabbed it in the eyes.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Gideon Jura tells the planeswalkers to split up through the city to save people and rally others, and Kaya recruits Rat and Teyo.
timeline.quote: We need to split up. Spread out through the city.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya leads Rat and Teyo across Ravnica toward Orzhova, saving people and telling them to shelter indoors, since Eternals do not enter buildings.
timeline.quote: The saving grace was that, for whatever reason, the Eternals weren't entering any of the buildings.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo, Kaya and Rat discuss the Gatewatch and Teyo admits he has killed only a spider.
timeline.quote: Never heard of 'Gatewatch' before today.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya's shortcut leads to a dead end, and Rat reveals the alley is a dead end as Eternals enter it.
timeline.quote: Another crop of Eternals had entered the mouth of the alley.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo expands his shield across the alley to hold the Eternals while Rat picks the lock of Krumnen's.
timeline.quote: I'll buy the time,

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo and Kaya save Gan Shokta from a dying Eternal, and Rat reveals Gan is her father.
timeline.quote: That's Gan Shokta. My father.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: The Gruul, Izzet and Simic forces fight together, and the group meets planeswalkers Kiora and Samut, who frees dead Eternals by name.
timeline.quote: You are free, Eknet.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Jace mind-calls everyone to retreat and meet at the Azorius Senate.
timeline.quote: Meet us at the Azorius Senate. Now.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya reaches Orzhova and asks her chief servitor to rally the Orzhov against Bolas.
timeline.quote: In an attempt to rally the Orzhov to fight Bolas and his Eternals

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: At the Senate House summit, Rat notes that most guilds are absent, and Rakdos blames the leaders for Hekara's death.
timeline.quote: Lord Rakdos blamed Master Zarek, Mistress Kaya, Miss Lavinia, and Mistress Vraska

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Gideon, encouraged by Ajani's reminder of the Oath, vows to retake Ravnica with Blackblade and the crowd gathers around him.
timeline.quote: With it, I hereby vow to take back this world. Who's with me?

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat leads Kaya, Teyo and Nissa through secret routes past the Eternals on the way to Selesnya.
timeline.quote: I know most of the secret routes through Ravnica

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo shields the group while Nissa asks an old birch tree to kill a crop of Eternals.
timeline.quote: Teyo put up a shield, and from behind it, Miss Revane asked permission of an old birch tree

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: The group finds the Selesnya Conclave fortified and hostile, with Nissa blamed for awakening Vitu-Ghazi.
timeline.quote: We found the Conclave well and truly fortified. And unwelcoming.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Emmara Tandris meets Kaya in the presence of the dormant dryad Trostani, and refuses to commit Selesnya because Ral's plans have been disasters.
timeline.quote: So far, every one has been an unmitigated disaster for the guilds, for Ravnica, and especially for Selesnya.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Ral succeeds in shutting down the Beacon, which Kaya and Teyo sense.
timeline.quote: Ral must have succeeded in shutting down the Beacon.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat leads Kaya and Teyo through the sewers, picking a lock, to Skarrg, where Gan Shokta and Borborygmos are fighting.
timeline.quote: Gan Shokta was fighting with the cyclops Borborygmos

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya ghosts through Ral and aims his face at Rat so he can see her; Rat explains she tracked him for Hekara.
timeline.quote: From behind, Mistress Kaya literally grabbed his face in both of her once-again-solidified hands and aimed it at, well . . . me.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: The group enters Korozda unopposed and Storrev welcomes them to Svogthos, with Rat whispering her name to Ral.
timeline.quote: The Golgari Swarm welcomes you to Svogthos.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Ravnican children and planeswalkers Mu Yanling, Jiang Yanggu and Huatli are lowered to safety through the grate.
timeline.quote: Miss Mu Yanling and Mister Jiang Yanggu

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: With the Golgari tunnels to Rix Maadi closed, the group surfaces and sees that the portal is gone from Tenth District Plaza, so the Planar Bridge has been shut down.
timeline.quote: Now, it was clear that Mister Fayden, Mister Karn, Miss Samut, and the Demon-Man Ob Nixilis had successfully shut down the Planar Bridge, as well.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: The party descends the Demon's Vestibule past Rakdos performers, whose puppeteer shows a Hekara marionette that throws razors at Zarek and Vraska.
timeline.quote: Seemingly of its own volition, the Hekara puppet threw very real razors at Zarek and Vraska.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: The party reaches the Festival Grounds and enters Rix Maadi, which is strangely empty.
timeline.quote: Queen Vraska muttered, "Screw it," and marched through the arched gothic doorway.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Representatives gather at the ruins of the Embassy of the Guildpact; Rat explains Operation Desperation and the Firemind's Vessel placed on Niv-Mizzet's bones.
timeline.quote: Chief Varryvort gently placed the Vessel atop Master Niv-Mizzet's blackened bones.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo shields all seventeen from the God-Eternal's fist until the ritual completes, then collapses.
timeline.quote: Teyo reached up with both hands and manifested a half sphere of light that covered all seventeen of us.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat protects Teyo, Kaya and Hekara during the fight.
timeline.quote: So I focused on protecting those three.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara performs with puppets and cannot remember what Rat looks like; Rakdos carries her off.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.
